rationale: The constructor used the working diagnosis to narrow the route from a two-format workspace plus services to a productized, fixed-price accepted-dataset handoff for one acquisition family. This changes every fingerprint field and the structured economics: the initial paid event is one accepted delivery, format and exception exposure are bounded, founder delivery evidence is collected before software investment, and annual recurring revenue is explicitly deferred rather than assumed. Existing evidence supports the unresolved human mapping and traceability work but not willingness to pay, repeat purchase, margin improvement or buyer count, so those remain explicit unknowns.
